topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I've just found out that someone has taken my artwork and...well, they got it tattooed on themselves. I’m not sure how to react. Part of me feels honored, like, wow, someone loves my work enough to put it on their skin forever. But the other part of me just feels a little...unsettled. Did they even reach out to me about it? What if they altered it? I just need some time to think about this, to really process what it means. Maybe once I’ve had a moment, I can reach out to them and maybe even start a conversation. It’s a bit overwhelming, you know?
